goal_check: test a structurally regularized market-anchored residual pool after H13 showed unstable unconstrained weights; no betting or ROI tuning

adaptive_origin_disclosure.consequence: H14 is an explicitly adaptive exploratory follow-up. Its reused historical late28 result cannot be independent evidence; only later prospective data can evaluate it.

allowed_input_scope.reader: unbuffered exact-block reader that stops immediately after the fourth VALID member block and never reads the TEST block
allowed_input_scope.required_alignment: rcDate, race_id, entry_id, win, and q must match exactly across all four member blocks

model.name: H14 convex market-residual log pool
model.equivalent_log_pool: p_w is proportional to q_i^(1-sum_m w_m) times product_m p_m(i)^w_m
model.constraints: w_m >= 0 for every member and sum_m w_m <= 1, so the equivalent market exponent is nonnegative
model.ordinary_features: none; q is the coefficient-one base margin and member probabilities contribute only market residuals
model.objective: mean race winner conditional negative log likelihood
model.gradient_check: central finite difference, epsilon 1e-6, maximum absolute error <=1e-6

chronological_fits.first64: fit one locked model and evaluate once on last28 dates
chronological_fits.last28: descriptive reused evaluation only; already inspected by H11D and H13
chronological_fits.all92: fit one deployment model and freeze before first target T-5
